prompt: How do I set the alarm on my F-91W watch?
reply: Put the alarm across the room so you have to stand up, and set it for the last minute you can actually get up: snoozing for nine minutes at a time just restarts the groggy part. Going to bed 30 minutes earlier fixes the reason you want to snooze better than any alarm app.
